svg.title: One run of the synchronization
svg.desc: The background job or the settings page starts a run. Paperless Sync takes the lock, checks the configuration, and tests the connection to Paperless-ngx and the base folder in Nextcloud. Inbox: it asks Paperless for the tasks of earlier uploads, removes imported files from Nextcloud and moves failed ones, uploads new, changed and due files to Paperless, and stores their tasks, refusals and retries in the database. Export: it reads every page of the documents, the trash and the metadata from Paperless, checks that every list came back complete, compares their paths and checksums with those in the database, downloads new and changed documents, writes, moves, trashes and deletes their files, and saves paths, checksums and missing runs. Finally it prunes empty folders, records the status and releases the lock.
